title: streaming: robust lifecycle controls for client cancel/disconnect, reconnect/resume, and server timeouts (OpenAI compat)
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: streaming clients can disconnect, cancel mid-stream, or try to reconnect/resume. The OpenAI compatibility layer previously made assumptions about single long-lived connections which caused resource leaks, duplicate function/tool calls, and inconsistent structured output when clients resumed or when the server enforced timeouts. This PR introduces lifecycle controls that: 1) surface client-initiated cancel events to the serving runtime and immediately stop token generation + background work; 2) detect abrupt disconnects and mark streams with a short grace window during which clients may reconnect and resume; 3) attach resume tokens to streaming sessions for safe reconnect/resume semantics (idempotent emit of function calls and structured outputs); 4) enforce server-side per-stream idle and overall generation timeouts to prevent runaway GPU usage and orphaned KV cache state; 5) integrate these behaviors into the OpenAI compatibility layer so downstream SDKs (Python/TS) get consistent semantics. Checklist: - [x] implement server-side lifecycle state machine and resume_token logic - [x] propagate client-cancel events to generator loop and kernel eviction path - [x] add unit + integration tests for reconnect/resume with function calling - [x] add metrics/tracing spans for lifecycle transitions - [x] update openai-compat adapter to return resume_token and stable structured function_call events - [x] document behavior in streaming compatibility guide (docs PR forthcoming) Related: ENG-9123 (streaming stability epic), SUP-421 (customer report about duplicate tool calls).
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) lifecycle: add stream state machine, cancel and disconnect handlers; 2) openai-compat: expose resume_token and idempotency markers for function calls; 3) tests: reconnect/resume integration tests + flakiness fixes to the streaming canary harness.

release_notes: Fix streaming disconnects and duplicate function/tool calls on reconnect. Adds resume_token to OpenAI compat streaming responses for safe reconnect/resume. Introduces server-side idle and generation timeouts (configurable).
tests_and_validation: Added unit tests for cancel propagation, disconnect->grace window, resume_token mismatch; added integration test exercising reconnect path with function_call and structured output; updated canary harness to exercise reconnect scenarios; e2e on dedicated infra passed in CI.
notes_for_backports: Non-breaking change; recommend cherry-picking to release/2026-02 for the dedicated clusters that reported SUP-421. Ensure config defaults are kept in backport to avoid behavior drift.
follow_up_work: Docs PR to expand streaming compatibility guide (docs/streaming/compatibility.md updated with a placeholder). Add SDK helpers examples in redwood-sdk-python and redwood-sdk-typescript. Consider exposing a per-tenant grace_window override behind feature flag. Tracked in ENG-9187.
